name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A hint popover placed by CSS anchor positioning, with a provider for delays, flipping, an arrow and a shortcut key cap. CSS-only motion.

.rx-tooltip.background: linear-gradient( 180deg, var(--_tip-sheen), transparent 40%, transparent 60%, var(--_tip-shade) ) padding-box, linear-gradient(var(--_tip), var(--_tip)) padding-box, linear-gradient(180deg, var(--_tip-edge-a), var(--_tip-edge-b)) border-box
.rx-tooltip.transition: opacity var(--_exit) var(--motion-ease), scale var(--_exit) var(--motion-ease), display var(--_exit) allow-discrete, overlay var(--_exit) allow-discrete

.rx-tooltip:popover-open.transition: opacity 140ms var(--motion-ease), scale var(--spring-unfold-duration) var(--spring-unfold), display var(--spring-unfold-duration) allow-discrete, overlay var(--spring-unfold-duration) allow-discrete
